name: Fix Destiny startup
command:
set -euo pipefail; env_file="${UA_WHATBOX_ENV_FILE:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/upload-assistant/whatbox.env}"; set -a; source "$env_file"; set +a; export SSHPASS="$UA_WHATBOX_PASSWORD"; timeout 180 sshpass -e ssh -4 -o ConnectTimeout=15 -o ServerAliveInterval=5 -o ServerAliveCountMax=2 -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes artemisprime@destiny.whatbox.ca bash -s <<'REMOTE'
set -euo pipefail
cd ~/Upload-Assistant-wastaken
compose=docker-compose.local.yml
backup="${compose}.bak.$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)-puid-fix"
cp -p "$compose" "$backup"
sed -i -e '/^[[:space:]]*PUID: "0"$/d' -e '/^[[:space:]]*PGID: "0"$/d' "$compose"
podman kill -s KILL upload-assistant-wastaken 2>/dev/null || true
podman rm -f upload-assistant-wastaken 2>/dev/null || true
podman pod rm -f upload-assistant-wastaken 2>/dev/null || true
podman compose -f "$compose" up -d upload-assistant-wastaken
sleep 20
printf 'backup=%s\n' "$backup"
podman ps -a --filter name=upload-assistant-wastaken --format '{{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}'
code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1:12347/api/health || true)
printf 'health_http=%s\n' "$code"
podman logs --since 25s upload-assistant-wastaken 2>&1 | tail -30 || true
REMOTE
description: Remove Destiny’s expensive root UID scan, cleanly recreate the container, and verify the WebUI on port 12347.
